sets.sql: SELECT [PriorityID],[PriorityCode],[PriorityName],[PriorityDescription],[PriorityRank],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.PriorityMaster WHERE IsActive=1 ORDER BY [PriorityID];

SELECT [PriorityID],[PriorityCode],[PriorityName],[PriorityDescription],[PriorityRank],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.PriorityMaster ORDER BY [PriorityID];

SELECT [RequestSourceCode],[RequestSourceName],[SourceDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.RequestSourceMaster WHERE IsActive=1 ORDER BY [RequestSourceCode];

SELECT [RequestSourceCode],[RequestSourceName],[SourceDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.RequestSourceMaster ORDER BY [RequestSourceCode];

SELECT t.TransitionID,t.FromStatusID,t.ToStatusID,s.StatusCode,s.StatusName,t.RequiresApproval,t.RequiresRemarks,t.RequiresForwardingConfirmation FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster f ON f.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusTransition t ON t.FromStatusID=r.CurrentStatusID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=t.ToStatusID WHERE r.RequestID=@RequestID AND f.IsTerminal=0 AND t.IsActive=1 AND s.IsActive=1 AND t.RequiredActorRole=@ActorRole AND (t.RequiresApproval=0 OR r.ApprovalStatus='APPROVED') ORDER BY s.DisplayOrder,s.StatusID;
SELECT [StatusID],[StatusCode],[StatusName],[StatusDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsTerminal],[IsActive] FROM dbo.TicketStatusMaster WHERE IsActive=1 ORDER BY [StatusID];
SELECT [StatusID],[StatusCode],[StatusName],[StatusDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsTerminal],[IsActive] FROM dbo.TicketStatusMaster ORDER BY [StatusID];

SELECT o.DropdownOptionID,o.DropdownListVersionID,o.OptionLabel,o.OptionValue,o.DisplayOrder,o.IsDefault FROM dbo.DropdownListOption o JOIN dbo.DropdownListVersion v ON v.DropdownListVersionID=o.DropdownListVersionID WHERE v.DropdownListID=@DropdownListID AND v.VersionStatus='PUBLISHED' AND o.IsActive=1 ORDER BY o.DisplayOrder,o.DropdownOptionID;

SELECT [CategoryID],[CategoryCode],[CategoryName],[CategoryDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceCategory WHERE [CategoryID]=@ID ORDER BY [CategoryID];

SELECT [CategoryID],[CategoryCode],[CategoryName],[CategoryDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedAt],COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceCategory ORDER BY [CategoryID] OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
SELECT [OptionID],[FieldID],[OptionLabel],[OptionValue],[DisplayOrder],[IsDefault],[IsActive],[CreatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceFieldOption WHERE FieldID=@FieldID ORDER BY [OptionID];

SELECT [FieldID],[VersionID],[FieldKey],[FieldLabel],[FieldType],[DropdownSourceType],[DropdownListVersionID],[Placeholder],[HelpText],[DefaultValue],[IsRequired],[IsReadOnly],[IsVisible],[MinLength],[MaxLength],[ValidationPattern],[DataSourceKey],[DisplayOrder],[IsActive],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceField WHERE VersionID=@VersionID ORDER BY [FieldID];

SELECT [NotificationConfigID],[VersionID],[EventCode],[ChannelCode],[TemplateID],[IsEnabled],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceNotificationConfig WHERE VersionID=@VersionID ORDER BY [NotificationConfigID];

SELECT [VersionID],[ServiceID],[VersionNumber],[VersionStatus],[CategoryID],[VersionServiceName],[VersionShortName],[VersionVeryShortName],[VersionServiceTitle],[VersionDescription],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[PublishedBy],[PublishedAt],[RetiredBy],[RetiredAt],[ChangeRemarks],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.ServiceVersion WHERE ServiceID=@ServiceID AND VersionStatus='DRAFT' ORDER BY [VersionID];

SELECT [VersionID],[ServiceID],[VersionNumber],[VersionStatus],[CategoryID],[VersionServiceName],[VersionShortName],[VersionVeryShortName],[VersionServiceTitle],[VersionDescription],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[PublishedBy],[PublishedAt],[RetiredBy],[RetiredAt],[ChangeRemarks],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.ServiceVersion WHERE ServiceID=@ServiceID ORDER BY [VersionID];

SELECT [VersionID],[ServiceID],[VersionNumber],[VersionStatus],[CategoryID],[VersionServiceName],[VersionShortName],[VersionVeryShortName],[VersionServiceTitle],[VersionDescription],[CreatedBy],[CreatedAt],[PublishedBy],[PublishedAt],[RetiredBy],[RetiredAt],[ChangeRemarks],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.ServiceVersion WHERE ServiceID=@ServiceID AND VersionStatus='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY [VersionID];

SELECT [WorkflowID],[VersionID],[DefaultPriorityID],[ApprovalTargetMinutes],[ResolutionTargetMinutes],[AllowForwardToBranch],[AllowForwardToDivision],[FollowUpRequired],[DefaultFollowUpMinutes],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceWorkflow WHERE VersionID=@VersionID ORDER BY [WorkflowID];

SELECT [ServiceID],[CategoryID],[ServiceCode],[ServiceName],[ShortName],[VeryShortName],[ServiceTitle],[Description],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceMaster WHERE [ServiceID]=@ID ORDER BY [ServiceID];

SELECT [ServiceID],[CategoryID],[ServiceCode],[ServiceName],[ShortName],[VeryShortName],[ServiceTitle],[Description],[IsActive],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedBy],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt],COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceMaster ORDER BY [ServiceID] OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
SELECT ActivityID,ActivityType,ActivityTitle,PerformedByRole,ActivityAt FROM dbo.ServiceRequestActivity WHERE RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY [ActivityID];

SELECT r.[RequestID],r.[TicketNumber],r.[ServiceID],r.[VersionID],r.[RequestTitle],r.[RequestSourceCode],r.[CardLast4],r.[PriorityID],r.[CurrentStatusID],r.[ApprovalStatus],r.[ApprovalDueAt],r.[ResolutionDueAt],r.[ApprovedAt],r.[CompletedAt],r.[ClosedAt],r.[CreatedByAgentName],r.[CreatedAt],r.[LastUpdatedByRole],r.[LastUpdatedAt],r.[NextFollowUpAt],r.[FollowUpRequired],r.[RowVersion],CASE WHEN CustomerMobile IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('***',RIGHT(CustomerMobile,4)) END AS MaskedCustomerMobile FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r WHERE r.RequestID=@RequestID;

columns.name: MaskedCustomerMobile
columns.expr: CASE WHEN CustomerMobile IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('***',RIGHT(CustomerMobile,4)) END

sets.sql: SELECT v.RequestFieldValueID,v.FieldID,v.FieldKeySnapshot,v.FieldLabelSnapshot,v.FieldTypeSnapshot FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFieldValue v JOIN dbo.ServiceRequest r ON r.RequestID=v.RequestID WHERE r.RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY v.RequestFieldValueID;

SELECT r.[RequestID],r.[TicketNumber],r.[ServiceID],r.[VersionID],r.[RequestTitle],r.[RequestSourceCode],r.[CardLast4],r.[PriorityID],r.[CurrentStatusID],r.[ApprovalStatus],r.[ApprovalDueAt],r.[ResolutionDueAt],r.[ApprovedAt],r.[CompletedAt],r.[ClosedAt],r.[CreatedByAgentName],r.[CreatedAt],r.[LastUpdatedByRole],r.[LastUpdatedAt],r.[NextFollowUpAt],r.[FollowUpRequired],r.[RowVersion],CASE WHEN CustomerMobile IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('***',RIGHT(CustomerMobile,4)) END AS MaskedCustomerMobile FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r WHERE r.TicketNumber=@TicketNumber;

columns.name: MaskedCustomerMobile
columns.expr: CASE WHEN CustomerMobile IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('***',RIGHT(CustomerMobile,4)) END

sets.sql: SELECT v.RequestFieldValueID,v.FieldID,v.FieldKeySnapshot,v.FieldLabelSnapshot,v.FieldTypeSnapshot FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFieldValue v JOIN dbo.ServiceRequest r ON r.RequestID=v.RequestID WHERE r.TicketNumber=@TicketNumber ORDER BY v.RequestFieldValueID;

SELECT s.StatusCode,s.StatusName,COUNT_BIG(r.RequestID) AS TicketCount FROM dbo.TicketStatusMaster s LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceRequest r ON r.CurrentStatusID=s.StatusID AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate GROUP BY s.StatusCode,s.StatusName,s.DisplayOrder ORDER BY s.DisplayOrder,s.StatusCode;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.PriorityID,p.PriorityCode,r.CurrentStatusID,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,r.RowVersion,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID WHERE r.ApprovalStatus='PENDING' AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt<@ToDate) ORDER BY p.PriorityRank,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.CreatedAt,r.RequestID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.PriorityID,p.PriorityCode,r.CurrentStatusID,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,r.RowVersion,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID WHERE s.IsTerminal=0 AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt<@ToDate) ORDER BY p.PriorityRank,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.CreatedAt,r.RequestID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
SELECT StatusHistoryID,FromStatusID,ToStatusID,ChangedByRole,ChangedAt FROM dbo.ServiceRequestStatusHistory WHERE RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY [StatusHistoryID];

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,r.PriorityID,r.CurrentStatusID,r.ApprovalStatus,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,r.NextFollowUpAt,r.RowVersion,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r WHERE (@TicketNumber IS NULL OR r.TicketNumber=@TicketNumber) AND (@CustomerMobile IS NULL OR r.CustomerMobile=@CustomerMobile) AND (@CBS_CIF IS NULL OR r.CBS_CIF=@CBS_CIF) AND (@AccountNumber IS NULL OR r.AccountNumber=@AccountNumber) AND (@CardClientID IS NULL OR r.CardClientID=@CardClientID) AND (@CardCIF IS NULL OR r.CardCIF=@CardCIF) AND (@CardLast4 IS NULL OR r.CardLast4=@CardLast4) AND (@InternetBankingUserID IS NULL OR r.InternetBankingUserID=@InternetBankingUserID) AND (@CustomerName IS NULL OR r.CustomerName LIKE '%'+REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@CustomerName,'[','[[]'),'%','[%]'),'_','[_]')+'%') AND (@ServiceID IS NULL OR r.ServiceID=@ServiceID) AND (@PriorityID IS NULL OR r.PriorityID=@PriorityID) AND (@StatusID IS NULL OR r.CurrentStatusID=@StatusID) AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate) AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR r.CreatedAt<@ToDate) ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT [FollowUpScheduleID],[RequestID],[RelatedFollowUpID],[RelatedForwardingID],[FollowUpSubject],[FollowUpDescription],[ScheduledAt],[ReminderStatus],[AssignedManagerID],[CreatedByManagerID],[CreatedByManagerRole],[CreatedAt],[CompletedByManagerID],[CompletedAt],[CompletionRemarks],[CancelledByManagerID],[CancelledAt],[CancellationReason],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFollowUpSchedule WHERE RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY [FollowUpScheduleID];

SELECT FollowUpScheduleID,RequestID,FollowUpSubject,ScheduledAt,AssignedManagerID,RowVersion,CASE WHEN ScheduledAt<SYSUTCDATETIME() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsOverdue,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFollowUpSchedule WHERE ReminderStatus='PENDING' AND ScheduledAt<=@Until ORDER BY ScheduledAt,FollowUpScheduleID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

columns.name: IsOverdue
columns.expr: CASE WHEN ScheduledAt<SYSUTCDATETIME() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

sets.sql: SELECT [FollowUpID],[RequestID],[FollowUpType],[FollowUpNote],[RelatedForwardingID],[CreatedByManagerID],[CreatedByManagerName],[CreatedByManagerRole],[AuthenticationSource],[CreatedAt] FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFollowUp WHERE RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY [FollowUpID];

SELECT [ForwardingID],[RequestID],[ForwardingType],[DestinationName],[ToAddresses],[CcAddresses],[EmailSubject],[EmailBody],[ForwardingRemarks],[SubmissionStatus],[EmailProviderMessageID],[SubmissionAttemptCount],[LastAttemptAt],[AcceptedAt],[FailureReason],[ForwardedByManagerID],[ForwardedByManagerName],[ForwardedByManagerRole],[AuthenticationSource],[CreatedAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.ServiceRequestForwarding WHERE RequestID=@RequestID ORDER BY [ForwardingID];

SELECT ForwardingID,RequestID,ForwardingType,SubmissionStatus,SubmissionAttemptCount,CreatedAt,RowVersion,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequestForwarding WHERE SubmissionStatus IN ('PENDING','SUBMITTING','FAILED') ORDER BY CreatedAt,ForwardingID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT o.OutboxID,o.CommunicationID,o.LockedBy AS LeaseID,o.LockedUntil,o.RowVersion,c.ChannelCode,c.EventCode,c.RecipientAddress,c.CcAddresses,c.MessageSubject,c.MessageBody,c.CorrelationID,o.EncryptedDeliveryPayload,o.PayloadKeyReference,o.PayloadExpiresAt FROM @Claimed x JOIN dbo.CommunicationOutbox o ON o.OutboxID=x.OutboxID JOIN dbo.CommunicationLog c ON c.CommunicationID=o.CommunicationID;

SELECT CommunicationID,RequestID,RelatedForwardingID,ChannelCode,EventCode,RecipientType,CommunicationStatus,ProviderMessageID,CorrelationID,CreatedAt,AcceptedAt,DeliveredAt,FailedAt,LastErrorCode,RowVersion FROM dbo.CommunicationLog WHERE CommunicationID=@ID ORDER BY [CommunicationID];

SELECT CommunicationID,RequestID,RelatedForwardingID,ChannelCode,EventCode,RecipientType,CommunicationStatus,ProviderMessageID,CorrelationID,CreatedAt,AcceptedAt,DeliveredAt,FailedAt,LastErrorCode,RowVersion FROM dbo.CommunicationLog WHERE RequestID=@ID ORDER BY [CommunicationID];

SELECT [TemplateID],[TemplateCode],[TemplateVersion],[TemplateName],[ChannelCode],[TemplateSubject],[TemplateBody],[TemplateStatus],[Description],[CreatedByManagerID],[CreatedAt],[PublishedByManagerID],[PublishedAt],[RetiredAt],[RowVersion] FROM dbo.NotificationTemplate WHERE TemplateCode=@TemplateCode AND TemplateStatus='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY [TemplateID];

SELECT [StatusMappingID],[InternalStatusID],[PublicStatusCode],[PublicStatusName],[PublicDescription],[DisplayOrder],[IsTerminal],[IsVisible],[IsActive],[CreatedAt],[UpdatedAt],[UpdatedByActorID] FROM dbo.CustomerStatusMapping ORDER BY [StatusMappingID];

SELECT CONVERT(bit,CASE WHEN DATALENGTH(@TokenHash)=32 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TicketTrackingToken WHERE TokenHash=CONVERT(binary(32),@TokenHash) AND IsRevoked=0 AND ExpiresAt>SYSUTCDATETIME()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsValid;

columns.name: IsValid
columns.expr: CONVERT(bit,CASE WHEN DATALENGTH(@TokenHash)=32 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TicketTrackingToken WHERE TokenHash=CONVERT(binary(32),@TokenHash) AND IsRevoked=0 AND ExpiresAt>SYSUTCDATETIME()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

sets.sql: SELECT r.TicketNumber,v.VersionServiceName AS ServiceDisplayName,r.CreatedAt,m.PublicStatusCode,m.PublicStatusName,m.PublicDescription FROM dbo.TicketTrackingToken t JOIN dbo.ServiceRequest r ON r.RequestID=t.RequestID JOIN dbo.ServiceVersion v ON v.VersionID=r.VersionID JOIN dbo.CustomerStatusMapping m ON m.InternalStatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE DATALENGTH(@TokenHash)=32 AND t.TokenHash=CONVERT(binary(32),@TokenHash) AND t.IsRevoked=0 AND t.ExpiresAt>SYSUTCDATETIME() AND m.IsActive=1 AND m.IsVisible=1;

WITH public_events AS(SELECT h.ChangedAt,h.StatusHistoryID,m.PublicStatusCode,m.PublicStatusName,m.PublicDescription,LAG(m.PublicStatusCode) OVER(ORDER BY h.ChangedAt,h.StatusHistoryID) AS PreviousCode FROM dbo.TicketTrackingToken t JOIN dbo.ServiceRequestStatusHistory h ON h.RequestID=t.RequestID JOIN dbo.CustomerStatusMapping m ON m.InternalStatusID=h.ToStatusID WHERE DATALENGTH(@TokenHash)=32 AND t.TokenHash=CONVERT(binary(32),@TokenHash) AND t.IsRevoked=0 AND t.ExpiresAt>SYSUTCDATETIME() AND m.IsActive=1 AND m.IsVisible=1)
SELECT ChangedAt,PublicStatusCode,PublicStatusName,PublicDescription FROM public_events WHERE PreviousCode IS NULL OR PreviousCode<>PublicStatusCode ORDER BY ChangedAt,StatusHistoryID;

SELECT AuditID,EventCode,EventCategory,EntityType,EntityID,RequestID,EventResult,OccurredAt,ActorType,ActorRole,ApplicationCode,CorrelationID,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.AuditLog WHERE ActorID=@SearchActorID AND OccurredAt>=@FromDate AND OccurredAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY OccurredAt DESC,AuditID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT AuditID,EventCode,EventCategory,EntityType,EntityID,RequestID,EventResult,OccurredAt,ActorType,ActorRole,ApplicationCode,CorrelationID,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.AuditLog WHERE RequestID=@RequestID AND OccurredAt>=@FromDate AND OccurredAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY OccurredAt DESC,AuditID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT AuditID,EventCode,EventCategory,EntityType,EntityID,RequestID,EventResult,OccurredAt,ActorType,ActorRole,ApplicationCode,CorrelationID,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.AuditLog WHERE 1=1 AND OccurredAt>=@FromDate AND OccurredAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY OccurredAt DESC,AuditID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT AuthenticationLogID,ActorType,ActorRole,AuthenticationSource,AuthenticationMethod,AuthenticationResult,FailureReasonCode,CorrelationID,ApplicationCode,EnvironmentCode,AuthenticatedAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.AuthenticationLog WHERE 1=1 AND AuthenticatedAt>=@FromDate AND AuthenticatedAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY AuthenticatedAt DESC,AuthenticationLogID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT IntegrationLogID,IntegrationCode,OperationCode,IntegrationType,RequestID,CorrelationID,EndpointCode,HttpStatusCode,IntegrationResult,StartedAt,CompletedAt,DurationMs,ErrorCode,IsRetryable,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.IntegrationLog WHERE IntegrationResult='FAILURE' AND StartedAt>=@FromDate AND StartedAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY StartedAt DESC,IntegrationLogID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT IntegrationLogID,IntegrationCode,OperationCode,IntegrationType,RequestID,CorrelationID,EndpointCode,HttpStatusCode,IntegrationResult,StartedAt,CompletedAt,DurationMs,ErrorCode,IsRetryable,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.IntegrationLog WHERE 1=1 AND StartedAt>=@FromDate AND StartedAt<@ToDate AND (@SearchCorrelationID IS NULL OR CorrelationID=@SearchCorrelationID) ORDER BY StartedAt DESC,IntegrationLogID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT CreatedByAgentID AS GroupKey,COUNT_BIG(*) AS TicketCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequest WHERE CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND CreatedAt<@ToDate GROUP BY CreatedByAgentID ORDER BY CreatedByAgentID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE s.StatusCode='COMPLETED' AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE p.PriorityCode IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH') AND s.IsTerminal=0 AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE s.StatusCode='FAILED' AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT PerformedByID AS ManagerID,ActivityType,COUNT_BIG(*) AS ActivityCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequestActivity WHERE PerformedByRole='MANAGER' AND ActivityAt>=@FromDate AND ActivityAt<@ToDate GROUP BY PerformedByID,ActivityType ORDER BY PerformedByID,ActivityType OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE r.ApprovalStatus='PENDING' AND r.ApprovalDueAt<SYSUTCDATETIME() AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT FollowUpScheduleID,RequestID,FollowUpSubject,ScheduledAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFollowUpSchedule WHERE ReminderStatus='PENDING' AND ScheduledAt<SYSUTCDATETIME() AND ScheduledAt>=@FromDate AND ScheduledAt<@ToDate ORDER BY ScheduledAt,FollowUpScheduleID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE r.ApprovalStatus='APPROVED' AND s.IsTerminal=0 AND r.ResolutionDueAt<SYSUTCDATETIME() AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS PendingApprovalCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequest WHERE ApprovalStatus='PENDING' AND CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND CreatedAt<@ToDate;

SELECT FollowUpScheduleID,RequestID,FollowUpSubject,ScheduledAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequestFollowUpSchedule WHERE ReminderStatus='PENDING'  AND ScheduledAt>=@FromDate AND ScheduledAt<@ToDate ORDER BY ScheduledAt,FollowUpScheduleID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE s.StatusCode='SENT_TO_BRANCH' AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.RequestID,r.TicketNumber,r.RequestTitle,r.ServiceID,p.PriorityCode,s.StatusCode,r.CreatedAt,r.ApprovalDueAt,r.ResolutionDueAt,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER() AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ServiceRequest r JOIN dbo.PriorityMaster p ON p.PriorityID=r.PriorityID JOIN dbo.TicketStatusMaster s ON s.StatusID=r.CurrentStatusID WHERE s.StatusCode='SENT_TO_DIVISION' AND r.CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND r.CreatedAt<@ToDate ORDER BY r.CreatedAt DESC,r.RequestID DESC OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT CONVERT(date,CreatedAt) AS GroupKey,COUNT_BIG(*) AS TicketCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequest WHERE CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND CreatedAt<@ToDate GROUP BY CONVERT(date,CreatedAt) ORDER BY CONVERT(date,CreatedAt) OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ServiceID AS GroupKey,COUNT_BIG(*) AS TicketCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequest WHERE CreatedAt>=@FromDate AND CreatedAt<@ToDate GROUP BY ServiceID ORDER BY ServiceID OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
